title: Channels
subtitle: Connect agents to your website. A channel only serves its published snapshot; drafts never affect what is live.
deleteBody: Delete “{{name}}”? The channel stops serving immediately.

fields.name: Name
fields.assistantHint: A channel serves exactly one agent.
fields.environmentHint: Production serves the agent's published version; development and staging serve the latest draft.
fields.originsHint: One per line, like https://www.example.com. Only these sites can use the widget (http only for localhost).
fields.typeLocked: A published channel cannot change its type.
fields.generated: is generated by the platform; see it in the integration code after publishing, and reset it if needed.
fields.secretHint: Stored encrypted; only the last four characters are shown afterwards.
fields.secretKeep: Already set; leave blank to keep it.

publish.submitted: Submitted to the approval center; it takes effect once approved.
publish.replaceBody: There is already a pending request. Withdraw it and submit again?
publish.snapshotNote: The runtime only reads the published snapshot; drafts never affect live traffic.

body.script: Paste this just before </body> on your page.
body.link: Share this link with users or put it in a menu.
body.webhook: Enter this address as the callback URL in the provider's console.
body.curl: Call this endpoint with a tenant API key.

rotate.body: After resetting the SDK key of “{{name}}”, pages with the old embed code stop working until you update them. Continue?
rotate.done: SDK key reset; update the embed code on your pages

openApi.title: Open API
openApi.intro: Call this agent from your own systems with a tenant API key.
openApi.authHint: Create one in Settings → API keys
openApi.versionsHint: Production keys call the published version; development/staging keys call the latest draft.
openApi.limitsHint: Above your plan's QPS you get 429 with Retry-After.
openApi.keysHint: With stream=true the reply is SSE.

keys.title: API keys
keys.subtitle: For your own systems to call agents; a key is shown only once, when created.
keys.name: Name
keys.revokeBody: Revoke “{{name}}”? It stops working immediately and callers get 401.
keys.copyNow: Copy the key now — it cannot be shown again:

wizard.componentsHint: Pick from the tenant library; only components compatible with this channel type are listed.
wizard.componentsNone: No compatible components. Copy a SaaS template in the Components tab.

experience.title: {{type}} · Experience
experience.loadFailed: Could not load the experience settings
experience.assistantHint: These apply to this agent's channels and override the tenant default; a channel's own Experience can override them again.
experience.note: Changes reach published channels only after they are published again.
